version.empty: Nothing found. Check the filters under "Show versions".
version.offlineCache: Mojang did not respond - showing the saved list.
version.offlineNoCache: Mojang did not respond and there is no saved list. Only installed versions are shown.
java.willDownload: not found, will be downloaded on launch
crash.title: The game closed
crash.outOfMemory: The game ran out of memory while starting. Close other programs (browser, code editor) or lower the memory given to the game in the settings.
loader.checking: Checking which loaders exist for this version…
java.howItWorks: Each game version needs its own Java. The launcher picks it automatically: if a matching one is already installed it is used, otherwise it is downloaded from Mojang, or from Adoptium when Mojang is unreachable. Downloaded runtimes are kept in the launcher folder and reused.
crash.heapIsNotAll: The figure above is the ceiling for the game itself. On top of it Java needs memory for textures and its own housekeeping, usually another 0.5-1.5 GB. So more free memory than allocated is still not necessarily enough.
jarmods.needsModLoader: Forge for this game version does not work on its own: it was built on top of ModLoader and will not start without it. ModLoader is someone else's mod and we are not allowed to distribute it, so find the file yourself and put it in this folder:
account.title: Accounts
account.expired: The sign-in has expired - sign in again
account.offlineExplain: No Microsoft sign-in. Good for single player, a LAN game, and servers that do not check for a licence. Ordinary servers will not let this account in.
account.nameBadCharacters: Latin letters, digits and underscore only
jarmods.hint: For versions before 1.6, where a mod is pasted inside the game file. Ordinary Forge and Fabric mods belong in the mods folder, not here.
javaArgs.explain: Added at the end of the launch command, where they override what the launcher worked out. Rarely needed - a mod or a graphics driver may ask for one. Leave it empty if you are not sure.
crashes.none: No reports - the game has not yet died in a way that leaves one.
crashes.trimmed: This is the start of the file; the rest is technical detail. "Show the file" opens all of it.
crash.heapTooBig: Java could not take as much memory as it was given, and the game never began to start. Nothing is lost - it will start with a smaller figure.
packs.title: Modpacks
packs.explain: A pack is a game of its own, with its own mods, settings and worlds. Its version and loader are chosen when it is made and answer for it from then on. Making one is optional: without a pack the launcher settings are in charge.
packs.createExplain: The version and the loader are bound to the pack straight away and do not change afterwards - mods are installed to fit them. For a different pairing, make another pack.
packs.deleteWarning: Its mods, settings and worlds go with it. The folder is moved to the recycle bin, so it can be brought back.
packs.vanillaNoMods: This pack has no mod loader, so there is nowhere for mods to go. Make a pack with Fabric, Forge, Quilt or NeoForge.
packs.nothingFound: Nothing found for this version and loader
loader.none: No loader builds were found for this version
packs.searchHint: Only mods that fit this version and loader are listed
packs.searchHintPacks: Only resource packs that fit this game version are listed
